messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Below is a **ready‑to‑use** list of the major *long‑weekend* public holidays that apply nationwide in Canada during 2023.  
(If your app needs province‑specific holidays—e.g., St. Patricks’ Day in Ontario/British Columbia, National Indigenous Peoples Day in BC, etc.—you’ll need to add those separately.)

| # | Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed If Falls On Weekend | Long‑Weekend Impact |
|---|---------|-------------|------------------------------|---------------------|
| 1 | **New Year’s Day** | January 1 (Sunday) | Mon Jan 2 | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| 2 | **Family Day** *(BC, ON, AB, SK)* | February 20 (Monday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun) |
| 3 | **St. Patrick’s Day** *(ON & BC)* | March 17 (Friday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Thu–Sat) |
| 4 | **Good Friday** | April 7 (Friday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Thu–Sat) |
| 5 | **Easter Monday** *(federal workers only)* | April 10 (Monday) | N/A | No (not a statutory holiday for most Canadians) |
| 6 | **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun) |
| 7 | **Canada Day** | July 1 (Saturday) | Sun July 3 | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Sat–Mon) |
| 8 | **Labour Day** | September 4 (Monday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun) |
| 9 | **Thanksgiving** | October 9 (Monday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun) |
|10 | **Remembrance Day** | November 11 (Wednesday) | Thu Nov 13 | No (but often treated as a “half‑holiday” in some provinces) |
|11 | **Christmas Day** | December 25 (Monday) | N/A | Yes — 3‑day weekend (Fri–Sun) |
|12 | **Boxing Day** | December 26 (Tuesday) | N/A | Yes — 4‑day weekend (Fri–Mon) |

### Quick Notes for App Integration

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Observance Rules** | When a holiday lands on a weekend, the next weekday becomes the official observance (unless otherwise specified). |
| **Province Variations** | Add province‑specific days such as Alberta’s Heritage Days, Manitoba’s Louis Riel Day, Quebec’s Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day, etc., if required. |
| **Holiday Names** | Use consistent naming conventions (`“National Indigenous Peoples Day”`, `“Saint‑John’s Day”`) to avoid confusion across regions. |
| **API Sources** | Many open APIs exist (e.g., https://date.nager.at/, https://calendarific.com/) that return JSON lists of national holidays—you might consider pulling directly rather than hardcoding. |
| **User Customization** | Allow users to toggle between “all federal holidays”, “province‑only holidays”, or “personalized custom holidays”. |

Feel free to copy/paste the above table into your database or UI component. Let me know if you’d like more granular province‑level data or help formatting it for a specific framework!
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends (public holidays) for Canada in 2023. They want it integrated into their holiday planning app.

We can provide them with a list of Canadian public holidays in 2023. But we should check if there's a tool available. There's no direct tool for fetching data; but maybe we could use the SimpleQuestion_ask function? That seems not relevant. We just need to give them the info. So let's produce a comprehensive list of federal public holidays in Canada for 2023, including dates and notes about whether they fall on weekdays/weekends. Also mention provinces where applicable. Provide details so they can incorporate into their app.

Let's do that. We'll include:

Federal holidays:
New Year's Day – Jan 1 (observed Jan 2)
Family Day – Feb 20 (Ontario, British Columbia, etc.)
St Patrick's Day – Mar 17 (some provinces)
Good Friday – Apr 7
Easter Monday – Apr 10 (federal employees only)
Victoria Day – May 22
Canada Day – Jul 1 (observed July 3 because falls on Saturday)
Labour Day – Sep 4
Thanksgiving – Oct 9
Remembrance Day – Nov 11 (observed Nov 13 due to falling on Sunday)
Christmas Day – Dec 25
Boxing Day – Dec 26

Also provincial holidays vary. For example, New Brunswick has Saint John’s Day, etc. Might also note that some holidays have different names per province.

But the user specifically said "long weekends". Typically those would be holidays that create extended weekends. In Canada, many holidays cause long weekends: New Year, Family day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas/Boxing Day. Some others may create longer breaks depending on region.

Thus we will present a table listing each holiday, its date, observed date if needed, and whether it's a long weekend (i.e., creates at least a three-day break). And perhaps highlight which ones are common across all provinces vs regional differences.

We'll keep it concise yet thorough.

Ok. Let's respond accordingly.
